André Jean René Lacrampe (14 April 1936 – 3 April 2015) was a French Roman Catholic archbishop. He served as the Archbishop of Montpellier from 1998 until his retirement in 2011. Ordained a priest in 1961, Lacrampe was appointed bishop of Ajaccio in 1983 before becoming Archbishop of Montpellier. He was known for his pastoral work and commitment to the Church in France. He passed away in 2015. 

If you would like more detailed information about his life, work, or contributions, please let me know!
